title: East Nashville Guest House
description:
Beautifully designed, light filled, guesthouse in Cleveland Park, steps from some of Nashville’s most acclaimed bars and restaurants. This stylish retreat offers curated interiors, modern comfort, and easy access to East Nashville, Germantown, and Downtown—perfect for exploring the city while enjoying a quiet, charming neighborhood vibe.

The space
Some great things about the space:

- Tons of natural light!
- Large king size bed!
- Pull out queen bed in living room!
- Full size kitchen!
- Outdoor space for coffee or cocktails!

Guest access
Guests have access to the entire guest house and outdoor patio.

Other things to note
I have lived in Nashville for over a decade and love sharing the best ways for you to enjoy the city to its fullest!
